_comment: #396 winter_teeth_prebank's start: the PRE-BANK COHORT. Identical to winter_teeth_start except survived_wolf_night is already 1 -- a player who fought the night wolves off river_wolf_pack's trigger_radius (quest-free, on_victory banks it) before the shepherd ever asked. That is the edge the quest design has to read as intentional rather than glitchy: accepting a_winter_of_teeth completes its resolve beat SILENTLY on accept (complete_when_any already satisfied) and the report row is waiting in the next hub. Two player actions, two toasts. hunter_will_come stays UNBANKED: the counter that fields the shepherd as an ally is not implied by having survived the wolves alone, and the hub's text_variant for this state ('You stood a watch before I ever asked.') is the one that must show. TRAP: rng_state is DERIVED (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; WISave restores .state directly and RNG_STATE_MIN_MAGNITUDE rejects small ints.
